meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮 NanoClaw 接入 iMessage 频道：拷贝适配器、注册、装依赖并重启，让机器人能用你的 iMessage 账号收发消息。接入分本地（这台 Mac）或远程（Photon 服务）两种模式。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等触发词，或要求接入 iMessage 频道时触发。

say.note: 会询问选用本地还是远程模式。
需要 macOS，并授予完全磁盘访问权限。
会要求提供 Photon 服务器地址与 API 密钥。

howto.what_en: Adds iMessage to NanoClaw by copying in the adapter, registering it, installing chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, rebuilding/validating, configuring env, and restarting — so the bot can send/receive iMessages via either the local Mac account or a remote Photon server.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc., or asks to integrate iMessage.

say_en.note: Prompts to choose local or remote mode.
Requires macOS and Full Disk Access.
Asks for the Photon server URL and API key.
